groups.title: Platform layout and deployment freshness
groups.proves: The full platform-doctor result: partition topology, helper copies, acceptance verdict freshness, install wiring, hooks, deployment freshness, launchd status, harness surface, trust archive and consumer roots. Raw findings remain visible by subcheck.

criteria: Run platform-doctor and preserve every subcheck's raw state; first-batch code/offline evidence does not make a live doctor finding green. The existing launchd exception is the only accepted exception.

subchecks.criteria: Preserve the current copy finding; verify the actual candidate copies after real migration and installation.
The R7 old-engine SHA remains stale evidence; never rewrite it as a current verdict.
Preserve the current wiring state; verify after an actual candidate installation.
Preserve the current hook state; verify real host wiring in the second batch.
Preserve the current freshness state; verify against the actually installed candidate.
Keep exactly the existing PLATFORM_LAUNCHD_NOT_ON_DUTY exception; it does not accept any other doctor finding.

Lawful declaration in the current source tree (MIN-235 D3, SUB-274 R14): platform-doctor reports a governed .claude that holds only a git-ignored per-host .claude/settings.local.json as PLATFORM_HARNESS_HOST_LOCAL, a host-specific raw result that stays red and is distinct from PLATFORM_HARNESS_UNDECLARED, which still reports any undeclared managed harness content. First batch: record each host's observed raw result as it is; it is never rewritten green. The ignored per-host .claude/settings.local.json is not a universal project requirement; do not move or delete it or declare it required on every host. Second batch: the host-specific reconciliation stays unresolved.

criteria: Re-run platform-doctor on the final candidate after actual migration, installation, and host wiring; close only findings supported by evidence, retain unresolved findings as red, and keep the launchd exception narrow.

groups.title: Every partition validates
groups.proves: Each chain replays, and its derived views match what the current engine projects. This is the group a view-shape change makes red until every chain is recovered.

criteria: Record existing validations from the installed old engine as baseline only; they do not prove candidate-engine migration or validation.
After real migration to the candidate engine, validate every partition and retain the actual result; no old-engine run substitutes.

groups.title: Product repository gates
groups.proves: The product repository that carries gates and is in MVP scope. Narrowed from DS+AOS to DS alone by Owner ruling on 2026-08-19: the MVP is the workflow and helper repositories, AOS integration is explicitly out of scope, and the AOS red (TCRN-CROSS-INC-234 -- three imports of the engine's MCP facade retired in v0.11.18) is a known exception to be repaired after MVP. Restoring AOS to this group is part of closing INC-234, not a separate decision. The pairing rationale this group originally carried -- a cross-repo change left one repository red for a day because only the author's gate got run -- is precisely what INC-234 caught again, and is why AOS returns here rather than leaving quietly.
